-- Phase 2: spec frozen, bodies filled in.
-- The channel is created with the given capacity and every element of xs
-- is offered with try_send. Each accepted send is counted until the
-- channel reports Full, then the loop stops.

accepted(cap: int, xs: List[int]) -> int uses nondet =
  pre cap >= 1
  post out >= 0
  post out <= xs.len()
  ex accepted(2, [1, 2, 3]) == 2
  ex accepted(3, []) == 0
  let (tx, rx) = Channel[int](cap)
  var n = 0
  for x in xs
    tx.try_send(x) else return n
    n += 1
  n
